exposure: Skin-to-skin (STS) immediately after cesarean birth in the OR
cohort: The study included all women having cesarean birth at Baylor All Saints Medical Center-Andrews Women's Hospital over a 90-day period.
finding: Maternal satisfaction was higher and maternal perception of pain was lower for women who experienced skin-to-skin in the operating room compared to those who did not.
mod_finding: Immediate skin-to-skin after cesarean birth in the operating room improved maternal satisfaction with the birth experience and reduced their perception of pain during surgery.
cross-section timing: Outcomes were evaluated immediately after cesarean birth in the operating room and during surgery, with postpartum interviews.
